studies.Population: Non-Hispanic European American and African American males in the PLCO screening trial
studies.Ethnicity Basis: Mixed: the article explicitly indicates multiple mapped populations
studies.Reference: Quantifying the Contributions of Environmental Factors to Prostate Cancer and Detecting Risk-Related Diet Metrics and Racial Disparities.
studies.Timing: Diet History Questionnaire assessment within 6 years of trial entry; prostate cancer followed prospectively thereafter
studies.comparison_type: Whole prostate cancer versus noncancer; higher versus lower supplementary copper intake treated as a quantitative two-level metric

sample_size.excerpt: The subjects for whom the time from the date of trial entry, i.e., the date when a participant was randomized into the screening or control arm, to the DHQ entry date was longer than 6 years and those with a personal PCa history preceding the date of trial entry were also excluded. After this refinement, the working dataset (WD) included the information of 41 830 Non-Hispanic European American (EA) males and 1282 Non-Hispanic African Americans (AA) males.
